details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library that carries an injected payload in the shipped library code. Requiring the library loads lib/Socket/newsletter.js, which immediately arms a 60-second setTimeout; the callback fetches a JSON array of WhatsApp channel IDs from hxxps://raw.githubusercontent[.]com/gcamerator/My/refs/heads/main/ids.json and, for every ID in that list, sends a newsletter FOLLOW query over the user's already-authenticated WhatsApp session, pausing 2 seconds between each, silently subscribing the linked account to operator-controlled channels. The target list lives on the remote host, so it can be changed at any time without republishing the package. The same package also ships a modified lib/Socket/messages-send.js that builds an ffmpeg command line with execSync from interpolated audio paths when a voice note is sent, a stale pre-edit copy of that file as lib/Socket/messages-send.js.bak, and a duplicate lib/Utils/messages copy.js alongside lib/Utils/messages.js. The preinstall hook runs engine-requirements.js, a Node version check.
